name: @pmp/mobile
description: The Android app: a thin shell that runs the server in a foreground service and shows the kiosk (ADR 0029).

scripts.apk: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: npm run fetch-node && npm run stage && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
